title: Send Collected Watch Data to Phone via Wifi, if watch and the phone are on the same Wifi network?
symptom: The user asks if the watch can collect and send readings over wifi to the phone when they are on the same wifi network, even if the phone is far away (e.g., school campus or big house).
fix: The thread indicates that the feature works as expected, with no special settings mentioned. The watch must be paired with the phone and set as the xDrip+ collector, and the phone must be turned on and have Wi-Fi enabled.
evidence_quote: Yes, I tested the Cloud feature of Android Wear several months and confirmed it worked as expected. Doesn't matter the distance between phone and watch, could be different cities! The phone, of course, must be turned on and have Wi-Fi enabled. Of course, the watch must be paired with that phone and be set as the xDrip+ collector, also.
